# Load data

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/df.RDS")
pclustering <- readRDS("./data/asr_clustering/blbli_asr_clustering_df.RDS")
tr <- read.tree("./data/tree/tree.treefile")
gwas_table <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_hits_table.RDS") 
gwas_hits <- readRDS("./data/GWAS/hits/gwas_mat.RDS")
nn <- readRDS("./data/nearest_neighbor_comparisons/nn_comparisons.RDS")

df <- left_join(df,gwas_hits %>% mutate(isolate_no = rownames(.))) %>% left_join(.,pclustering)
```

# S Figure 4A - Table

```{r}
# Curate table
s_figure_4.A_tb <- gwas_table %>% select(locus_tag,gene,product,resistance_category,sig_tests,sig_models_simple,sig_phenotypes,nn_qc)

# Update locus tag and gene and product for informative data
s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag <- recode_genotypes(s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag)
s_figure_4.A_tb$gene <- ifelse(grepl(pattern = 'ompK36|OmpK36',s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag) | s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag =='KPNIH1_RS18665',"ompK36",s_figure_4.A_tb$gene) %>% {ifelse(is.na(.),"",.)}
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <- ifelse(grepl("KPNIH1_RS18100", s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag),
                                  "MdtA/MuxA family multidrug efflux RND transporter periplasmic adaptor subunit",
                                  s_figure_4.A_tb$product)
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <- ifelse(s_figure_4.A_tb$gene=='ompK36','porin OmpC',s_figure_4.A_tb$product)
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <- ifelse(grepl(pattern = 'KPC',s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag),"blaKPC-associated plasmid cluster",s_figure_4.A_tb$product)
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <- ifelse(grepl("SHV-11|TEM-1D", s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag),"Broad-spectrum β-lactamase",s_figure_4.A_tb$product)
s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag <- gsub("blaKPC-","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-",s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag)
s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag <- gsub("ompK36","<i>ompK36</i>",s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag) 
s_figure_4.A_tb$gene <- gsub("ompK36","<i>ompK36</i>",s_figure_4.A_tb$gene) 
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <- gsub("blaKPC","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>",s_figure_4.A_tb$product) 
s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag <-  gsub("associated","containing",s_figure_4.A_tb$locus_tag)
s_figure_4.A_tb$product <-  gsub("associated","containing",s_figure_4.A_tb$product)
s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple <- gsub("KPC-","<i>bla</i><sub>KPC</sub>-",s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple) %>% gsub("associated","containing",.)
s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple <- gsub("High-risk variants","PFAV",s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple)

# Recode PFAV at first mention
idx <- which(grepl("PFAV", s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple))[1]
s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple[idx] <- gsub(
  "PFAV",
  "Putative function-altering variants (PFAVs)",
  s_figure_4.A_tb$sig_models_simple[idx])

# Select relevant columns
s_figure_4.A_tbl <- s_figure_4.A_tb %>%
  select(locus_tag, gene, product, sig_tests, sig_models_simple, sig_phenotypes, nn_qc) %>%
  `colnames<-`(c('Significant hit', 'Gene', 'Product', 'Significant test(s)',
                 'Significant model(s)', 'Phenotype(s)', 'Nearest neighbor criterion'))

# Table
tbl_html <- s_figure_4.A_tbl %>%
  kable(format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = FALSE,
        align = c("l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l", "l")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("condensed", "responsive"),
                full_width = TRUE, fixed_thead = TRUE,
                font_size = 47, html_font = "Arial") %>%
  column_spec(1:ncol(s_figure_4.A_tbl),                                 # all columns, header included
              extra_css = "padding-left: 0.3em; padding-right: 0.3em;",
              include_thead = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%                # Significant hit: no wrapping
  column_spec(3, width = "22%") %>%                                     # Product
  column_spec(4, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%                # Significant test(s)
  column_spec(6, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;") %>%                # Phenotype(s)
  column_spec(7, extra_css = "white-space: nowrap;", include_thead = TRUE) %>%   # Nearest neighbor criterion
  row_spec(0, background = "lightgray", color = "black", bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(1:nrow(s_figure_4.A_tbl), background = "white",
           extra_css = "border-top: 3px solid #bdbdbd;")

save_kable(x = tbl_html, file = "tab_kbl.html")

webshot2::webshot(url = "tab_kbl.html", file = "tab_kbl.png",
                  vwidth = 4100, vheight = 2000, selector = "table")
```

# Legend
```{r} 
# Legend from a real variable, using the same scale as the panel
data_legend <- function(data, var, scale, glyph = "rect", key_border = TRUE) {
  data <- as.data.frame(data)
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[var]]), , drop = FALSE]
  data[[var]] <- factor(data[[var]])
  outline <- if (glyph == "boxplot") "black" else NA        # outline only the boxplot symbol
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[var]], fill = .data[[var]])) +
    geom_bar(key_glyph = glyph, colour = outline, linewidth = 0.2) +
    scale + consistent_theme_GWAS
  if (!key_border) p <- p + theme(legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA, fill = NA))
  cowplot::get_legend(p)
}

# Genotype: all hit columns combined, so both Present and Absent appear
genotype_long <- data.frame(genotype = as.vector(as.matrix(s_figure_4.df_mat)))

leg_clade      <- data_legend(df, "clade_I", clade_colors_scale_v)
leg_phylo      <- data_legend(df, "blbli_asr_cluster_renamed", cluster_scale_3_col_key)
leg_resistance <- data_legend(df, "blbli_dich", resistance_scale_key)
leg_mic        <- data_legend(df, "MVB_log_2", Log2_scale_gwas_figure)
leg_genotype   <- data_legend(genotype_long, "genotype", genotype_scale_v)
leg_antibiotic <- data_legend(nn_data_melt, "variable", MVB_IR_scale,
                              glyph = "boxplot", key_border = FALSE)

legs <- list(leg_clade, leg_phylo, leg_resistance, leg_mic, leg_genotype, leg_antibiotic)

# Measure each legend's width and height (in inches)
w <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertWidth(sum(g$widths),  "in", valueOnly = TRUE))
h <- sapply(legs, function(g) grid::convertHeight(sum(g$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE))

# Pad the bottom of each legend to match the tallest, so all titles line up
legs <- mapply(function(g, hi) gtable::gtable_add_rows(g, unit(max(h) - hi, "in"), pos = -1),
               legs, h, SIMPLIFY = FALSE)

# Spacing: equal gaps between legends, equal padding on both sides (7.05 = figure width)
gap <- 0.12
pad <- max((7.05 - sum(w) - gap * (length(legs) - 1)) / 2, 0)
rel <- c(pad, as.vector(rbind(w, gap))[-2 * length(w)], pad)

# Interleave legends with NULL spacers: NULL, leg1, NULL, leg2, ..., leg6, NULL
cells <- c(list(NULL),
           unlist(lapply(seq_along(legs), function(i)
             if (i < length(legs)) list(legs[[i]], NULL) else list(legs[[i]])),
             recursive = FALSE),
           list(NULL))

s_figure_4.legends <- do.call(plot_grid, c(cells, list(nrow = 1, rel_widths = rel)))
```

```{r ,fig.height=6.5,fig.width=7.05}
# ===== Panel A: table =====
info  <- magick::image_info(magick::image_read("tab_kbl.png"))

fig_h <- 6.5                                    # total figure height (in); max 10.24
tbl_w <- 6.65                                   # table width (in), leaving ~0.15 in each side
tbl_h <- tbl_w * info$height / info$width       # height the table needs at that width
a     <- 1.155 * tbl_h / (fig_h - tbl_h)        # panel A's share (1 + 0.155 = panels + legend row)

s_figure_4.A_img <- ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_image("tab_kbl.png")
unlink(c("tab_kbl.html", "tab_kbl.png"))

s_figure_4.FA <- plot_grid(s_figure_4.A_img, labels = "A", label_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.05, 0, 0, 0), "cm"))
```

```{r ,fig.height=6.5,fig.width=7.05}
# ===== Panel B: tree, no legends =====
s_figure_4.FB <- plot_grid(s_figure_4.phylo + theme(legend.position = "none"),
                           labels = "B", label_size = 12)

# ===== Panels C and D, no legends =====
s_figure_4.FCD <- plot_grid(
  s_figure_4.C + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  s_figure_4.D + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  nrow = 2, labels = c("C", "D"), label_size = 12, align = "hv", label_x = -0.02)

# ===== Assemble: table / panels B-D / shared legend row =====
s_figure_4.FBCD <- plot_grid(s_figure_4.FB, s_figure_4.FCD, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 0.7))

leg_share <- 0.125
a <- (1 + leg_share) * tbl_h / (fig_h - tbl_h)

s_figure_4 <- plot_grid(s_figure_4.FA, s_figure_4.FBCD, s_figure_4.legends,
                        nrow = 3, rel_heights = c(a, 1, leg_share))
s_figure_4
```
